results.title: Copilot Microsoft is rated "Bad" with 1.5 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
Considering 230 reviews, most reviewers were let down by their experience overall. People frequently mentioned that the application is exceptionally frustrating and time-consuming because it constantly loses track of previous conversations and forgets important details. Reviewers noted that the artificial intelligence provides incorrect information, struggles with file handling, and makes unwarran ted assumptions during interactions. The minority of people were satisfied with the platform, noting it serves as a genuinely helpful tool for brainstorming new ideas and creative writing tasks. Some reviewers also found the application quite useful for supporting specific daily activities, personal organization, and improving their overall computer device performance.See more [...] ## Subjectcopilot
Subject: Feedback About Recent Copilot Usage Limits  
Dear Microsoft Team,  
I would like to express my disappointment regarding the recent usage limits introduced in Copilot.  
I am not a business user and I do not use Copilot for professional or corporate purposes. I use it as a personal assistant for everyday tasks, such as writing emails, correcting text, improving sentences, organizing my thoughts, and helping me avoid mistakes in daily communications.  
Recently, I received a message saying that I had reached my daily limit and would need to wait before continuing. This was frustrating and disappointing, as I have been using Copilot as a simple personal support tool and had never experienced this issue before. [...] What frustrates me most is not the interface change itself. It is the loss of trust. As a small business owner, my time is valuable. When I invest that time teaching an AI platform my workflows and business processes, I expect Microsoft to protect that investment or provide a clear migration path.  
  
Instead, I have been left trying to determine whether I need to rebuild everything from scratch, and I have been unable to obtain a clear answer from support about the future relationship between Notebooks and Cowork.  
  
I subscribe to Microsoft 365 because I need reliable tools to run my business. This experience has made me question whether Microsoft understands the impact these changes have on paying customers who depend on Copilot as part of their daily operations.

CopilotKitDocs

# Common Copilot Issues

Network errors, endpoint not found, tunnel timeouts, and other common issues when wiring up CopilotKit with the Built-in Agent.

Open your coding agent in your project's folder, or in an empty folder for a new app.This runs in a coding agent on your computer.

Welcome to the CopilotKit troubleshooting guide. This page covers the most common issues you'll hit while wiring up a Built-in Agent, plus the usual fixes.

Have an issue not listed here? Open a ticket on GitHub or reach out on Discord and we'll help. PRs adding your own troubleshooting notes are very welcome.

## Network errors / API not found#

If you're getting network or API errors, here's how to troubleshoot.

Check your endpoint configuration

Verify the configured `runtimeUrl`. [...] Verify the configured `runtimeUrl`.

```
<CopilotKit runtimeUrl="/api/copilotkit">< CopilotKit  runtimeUrl ="/api/copilotkit"> {/ Your app /} {/ Your app /}CopilotKit>CopilotKit> CopilotKit>
```

Or, if you're using CopilotCloud:

```
<CopilotKit publicApiKey="">< CopilotKit  publicApiKey = ""> {/ Your app /} {/ Your app /}CopilotKit>CopilotKit> CopilotKit>
```

Common issues:

 Missing leading slash in the endpoint path
 Wrong path relative to your app's base URL (or, if absolute, wrong full URL)
 Typos in the endpoint path

 Using CopilotCloud but also setting `runtimeUrl`. Omit `runtimeUrl` and keep only `publicApiKey`

localhost vs 127.0.0.1

If you're running locally and getting connection errors, try `127.0.0.1` instead of `localhost`: [...] ```
curl -v -d '{}'  curl -v -d '{}' 
```

You should see a `200 OK` and a JSON body like:

```
{{ "actions": [],  "actions": [], "agents": [ "agents": [ { "name": "my_agent", "description": "A helpful agent.", "type": "langgraph_agui" } { "name": "my_agent", "description": "A helpful agent.", "type": "langgraph_agui" } ], ], "sdkVersion": "0.1.32"  "sdkVersion": "0.1.32"}}
```

If you see a different response, check your server logs.

## Tunnel creation hangs#

If the tunnel creation process spins indefinitely, your router or ISP might be blocking the tunnel service.

Router / ISP blocking tunnel connections

Verify connectivity:

```
ping tunnels.devcopilotkit.com ping tunnels.devcopilotkit.comcurl -I  curl -I  tunnels.devcopilotkit.com 443 telnet tunnels.devcopilotkit.com  443
```
